categories.main_business_segments: Guobo Electronics primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of active phased array T/R modules and radio frequency (RF) integrated circuit products. Their product portfolio includes T/R modules, RF modules, RF amplifier chips, and RF control chips, serving applications in active phased array radar, mobile communication base stations, terminals, satellite communication, and sensing systems.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages compound semiconductor technology, including GaN (gallium nitride) and GaAs (gallium arsenide), to develop high-frequency, high-density integrated T/R modules and RF integrated circuits. They utilize advanced manufacturing methods such as high-density 3D integration, automated testing platforms, and advanced packaging technologies including metal-ceramic and plastic encapsulation. The company operates a fabless model for chip design, outsourcing wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing to third parties.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include research institutes, system integrators, and leading domestic mobile communication equipment manufacturers. The company serves specialized markets such as defense radar systems, commercial aerospace, satellite communications, and mobile communication base stations (4G, 5G, and emerging 6G). They also supply RF chips to terminal device manufacturers including smartphones, drones, and IoT devices.
categories.geographic_coverage: Guobo Electronics primarily operates within China, with its headquarters and main production facilities located in Nanjing, Jiangsu Province. The company’s sales and operations focus on the domestic market, serving Chinese research institutions, defense contractors, and communication equipment manufacturers.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain, focusing on chip design, module and component assembly, and testing. It outsources wafer fabrication and packaging to upstream foundries and subcontractors, while delivering integrated RF solutions downstream to system integrators and equipment manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing high-frequency, high-density integration technologies for active phased array T/R modules and RF ICs, expanding GaN-based RF module applications for 5G-A and 6G communications, and developing integrated communication and sensing chips. The company invests heavily in R&D, focusing on digital design automation, heterogeneous integration, and low-power, high-linearity RF chip design. It also targets emerging markets such as satellite communications, low-altitude economy, and smart transportation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of T/R modules, RF modules, and RF integrated circuits. The company recognizes revenue at the point of delivery and acceptance by customers, with some contracts involving variable pricing subject to government pricing approvals. It also earns income from providing related R&D services and receives government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Guobo Electronics is a leading domestic provider of active phased array T/R modules and RF integrated circuits, with core technologies at the domestic leading and internationally advanced levels. It faces competition from large international RF component manufacturers such as Skyworks, Qorvo, and Sumitomo, especially in general market segments. The company maintains a strong position in specialized defense and communication markets in China.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.59 billion, a 27.36% decrease from the previous year, mainly due to reduced sales in T/R modules and RF modules. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 484.65 million, down 20.06%. R&D investment accounted for 12.62% of revenue, increasing from prior years. The company has total assets of about RMB 7.99 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of RMB 6.19 billion, reflecting a stable but slightly declining asset base and moderate profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Guobo Electronics emphasizes its core competence in compound semiconductor technology and high-density integration, enabling it to deliver high-performance, compact, and reliable active phased array T/R modules and RF ICs. Its products support critical applications in defense radar, advanced mobile communications (including 5G-A and 6G), satellite communications, and sensing, offering customers cutting-edge technology with domestic supply chain security. The company’s integrated product portfolio from chips to modules and components provides comprehensive RF front-end solutions tailored to customer needs.
